description: Sunrays Textile Mills Limited was incorporated in Pakistan on 27 August 1987 and is principally engaged in the trade, manufacture and sale of yarn. Its mill, on 114 kanals and 10 marlas, is at Khanpur Shumali in District Muzaffargarh, and ginning units and ice factories it has operated under leasing arrangements were not operational during the year. The company is part of the Indus Group and shares its registered office in Karachi with Indus Dyeing & Manufacturing Company Limited.
headOffice: Office No. 508, 5th Floor, Beaumont Plaza, Beaumont Road, Civil Lines, Karachi 75530, Pakistan
